methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $12M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
BotBuilt is a Seed-stage construction technology company founded by Barrett Ames, Colin Devine, and Brent Wadas. The company has raised $12.4M to date. The relevant private comp universe in Housing & Construction is limited, with only one identified private peer (Apis Cor) and no public comparables available for direct benchmarking.

Given the early stage and limited comp availability, stage-progression methodology is the primary applicable valuation approach. Using total capital raised ($12.4M) as a proxy for implied pre-money value, a typical Seed-to-Series A step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $31M. This methodological anchor reflects standard venture progression patterns in construction technology, though the reliance on a single approach introduces meaningful model risk.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $26M to $36M (median $31M), with the low and high bounds reflecting reasonable variance around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the sparse private comp set, absence of public trading comparables, and early revenue/profitability data that would typically inform construction-tech valuations. The limited available peer universe means this range should be viewed as preliminary; additional comp analysis or revenue-based approaches would strengthen conviction once more operating metrics are available.
